_metadata.scope_note: Export & release flow: export dialog, mastering/loudness check, stems, metadata and distribution. Error strings stay in errors.*.

export.format_wav_flac_hint: WAV/FLAC Export keeps full quality — best for mastering and distribution.
export.format_mp3_hint: MP3 Export creates a smaller file that's easy to share and preview.
export.loudness_too_loud_warning: Your track is louder than most streaming platforms allow. It may be turned down on playback.
export.metadata_cta: Edit details in the Track Metadata Editor
export.success_toast: Export complete. Your file is ready to download.

_notes.format_label: Field label above the format selector. One word if possible.
_notes.format_wav_flac_hint: Helper text under the WAV/FLAC option. 'WAV/FLAC Export' is an ontology feature name. WAV and FLAC are never translated.
_notes.format_mp3_hint: Helper text under the MP3 option. 'MP3 Export' is an ontology feature name. MP3 is never translated.
_notes.mastering_chain_toggle: Toggle label. 'Mastering Chain' is an ontology feature name. [EXPANSION RISK] Toggle row has limited width.
_notes.loudness_check_title: Panel title. 'Loudness Analyzer' is an ontology feature name.
_notes.loudness_result: [PLACEHOLDER] {lufs} and {target_lufs} are decimal numbers formatted at runtime (e.g. '-14.0'). LUFS is a technical unit — do not translate.
_notes.loudness_too_loud_warning: Inline warning banner. Friendly, not alarming.
_notes.stems_option: Checkbox label. 'Stem Separation' is an ontology feature name. [EXPANSION RISK]
_notes.stems_count_singular: [PLURAL] {count} = integer. Apply ICU plural rules for target locale.
_notes.metadata_cta: Secondary button/link. 'Track Metadata Editor' is an ontology feature name.
_notes.distribution_cta: Primary button. 'One-Click Distribution' is an ontology feature name. [EXPANSION RISK] Button width is fixed.
_notes.progress_label: [PLACEHOLDER] {track_name} is user-generated content — do not translate. {percent} is an integer 0–100.
